```yaml
name: Check Discord Link Health

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 */12 * * *'  # Every 12 hours
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  check-discord-link:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      issues: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Get existing open issues with discord-link label
        id: get_issues
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          script: |
            const { data: issues } = await github.rest.issues.listForRepo({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              state: 'open',
              labels: 'discord-link'
            });
            return issues.length > 0;

      - name: Check Discord invite link health
        id: check_link
        if: steps.get_issues.outputs.result != 'true'
        run: |
          DISCORD_INVITE_CODE="f2AjwV2AN"
          API_URL="https://discord.com/api/v10/invites/${DISCORD_INVITE_CODE}"
          
          RESPONSE=$(curl -s -w "%{http_code}" -o /tmp/discord_response.txt "$API_URL")
          
          if [ "$RESPONSE" -eq 200 ]; then
            echo "Link is healthy"
            exit 0
          else
            echo "Link is broken with status code: $RESPONSE"
            echo "response_body=$(cat /tmp/discord_response.txt)" >> $GITHUB_ENV
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Create issue if link is broken
        if: failure() && steps.get_issues.outputs.result != 'true'
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          script: |
            const { data: issue } = await github.rest.issues.create({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              title: 'Discord invite link is invalid',
              body: `The Discord invite link https://discord.gg/f2AjwV2AN appears to be invalid or expired.\n\nResponse: \`\`\`${process.env.response_body}\`\`\``,
              labels: ['discord-link']
            });
            
            console.log(`Created issue: ${issue.html_url}`);
```
